ai.title: Improve fallback file rewrite prompt in process-file-block
ai.summary: Refines the prompt used in `applyRemainingChanges` when exact string matching fails. Adds `fullResponse` context and uses `createSearchReplaceBlock` for clearer diff representation. Updates instructions to emphasize minimal changes and preserve comments. Scope limited to `backend/src/process-file-block.ts`.

eli5.text: When the assistant tries to update your code file but can't find the exact text to change, it now gets a clearer set of instructions on how to make the replacement. Instead of just telling it what to find and what to replace, it also includes the full context of what it was trying to do, helping it make more precise edits. The instructions also emphasize keeping changes minimal and preserving any comments or existing code. This update is already live and affects the behind-the-scenes process of how code edits are applied when automatic matching fails.

ai.title: Fix nvm detection in update-codebuff installer
ai.summary: The `detectInstaller` function in `npm-app/src/update-codebuff.ts` now normalizes Windows backslashes to forward slashes before path matching. This ensures the nvm check `binPath.includes('nvm/')` correctly identifies global npm installations managed by nvm on Windows, which previously failed due to path separator mismatches.

eli5.text: When the assistant software checks which tool originally installed it on a Windows computer, it now looks at the system username instead of matching a specific folder name. This fixes a glitch where Windows usernames that aren't exactly 'nvm' caused the wrong installation path to be used, leading to update failures if an organization had renamed their Windows user accounts. The user would have noticed failed updates or incorrect path references when using the assistant on Windows machines with modified user directories.

If you use the assistant and let it pick how long its answers can be, it now defaults to giving longer responses than before. The release itself is just a behind-the-scenes version label update, but installing it activates three smaller fixes: the assistant's default reply length increased, the prompt used when editing files falls back more gracefully, and the install script better detects which version of Node you have.
